title: Production strategy
description: Added in 1.1.0: the FinanceModel-owned production-strategy document held at /finplan/<env>/financemodel/config/production-strategy. FinanceModel's strategy-selection operation is the single writer; the FinancialPlanning daily trigger role reads it. An absent key, an empty value or a document without strategy_id means no production strategy: the daily trigger records skipped_no_strategy and submits nothing.

selected_by.description: Caller principal name that selected the strategy (never a credential).
